summary_en: Code-to-description association unconfirmed. Source notes: a Westerplatte attack-and-defense scenario for up to 10 German-side and 15 Polish-side players, with a 20-minute peace period and landing restrictions.
description: 按文档顺序，该段说明位于map-981104b9之后，地图码关联尚待确认。据原文，德国进攻、波兰防守；双方分别以对应国家市政厅和27名工人开局，德国最多10名玩家，波兰最多15名玩家。德国电脑拥有1艘战列舰、炮塔和1艘飞艇；波兰电脑拥有2艘战列舰、16艘巡逻艇、1艘鱼雷艇、炮塔和1艘飞艇。限制为：波兰不能攻击或在“德国”区域登陆；德国不能建造“巨人”；任何一方不得在灰色区域登陆。设20分钟和平期。原文另记“开局拥有10,000名苏尔克”，其含义不明，保留待核实。以上为原文记录，尚未测试验证。
description_en: In document order, this paragraph follows map-981104b9; that code-to-description association still needs confirmation. The source describes Germany attacking and Poland defending. Poland may not attack or land in the 'German' area; Germany may not build the unit called '巨人' in the source; neither side may land in gray areas. There is a 20-minute peace period.
